snippet.title: Sated - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Gurgling messes of flesh live beneath. They seek to be sated. Your cursed fridge beckons: spin the wheel and choose revolting ingredients in this rogue-like-inspired cooking course from the very depths of hell. Leave your customers satisfied or become the meal yourself.
